strings.name: Ridley Scott
strings.summary: Scott moved from design, television and advertising into features. Alien and Blade Runner built industrial science-fiction worlds, while Thelma & Louise, Gladiator and The Martian show his range. His direction emphasizes design, lighting and world-building. An honorary Oscar was announced in 2026, with its ceremony after this dossier’s cutoff.
